_doc: ENCOUNTERS for The Squeeze. 'party' lists character ids from characters/ (empty = use the active campaign party). 'enemies' instantiate templates from enemies/enemies.json with per-instance overrides. bossPhases fire once when the referenced enemy drops below hpBelow. Balance targets baseline (no-resonance) damage: a fresh hero with ~300 HP and 3-4 starter abilities can win each fight on baseline damage alone.

encounters.name: The 4 AM Unload
encounters.description: Forty-eight feet of freight in a dead building. You versus the wall, with the ballast hum grinding in your ears.

encounters.name: Front-End Storm
encounters.description: The hour-occupancy dashboard is red, and management's pet is running the paging wand. Hold the floor.

encounters.name: The Manager's Office
encounters.description: The poisoned email, CC'd to everyone, and the woman who sent it, smiling behind the desk. Everything you built this act is on the line.

bossPhases.bannerText: MATTIE-T PIVOTS — THE EMAIL GOES WIDE
bossPhases.narrationText: Mattie-T keys three sentences and hits send. A fresh copy of the poisoned email slithers onto the floor.
The quarterly squeeze hits the store: hours slashed mid-shift, the crew scattered, and the board demanding blood. The building itself leans on you.
